metadata.patch_name: Staging Buffer Scope Isolation Fix - CRITICAL
metadata.author: System (based on Job Workflow v1.6.3 fix)
metadata.bug_reference: Same bug as Job Workflow BUG-1.6.2-001

bug_analysis.title: QA Engine V2 can still access Artist metadata despite ignore_artist_metadata flags
bug_analysis.root_cause: Validation functions have access to both Artist output AND staging_buffer in scope

evidence.job_workflow_precedent: v1.6.2 had identical issue - 'ignore' flags insufficient
evidence.job_workflow_symptom: QA reported 129 words but actual text was 111 words
evidence.lic_vulnerability: LIC v10.23 has same architecture flaw - no hard scope isolation
evidence.risk: Artist can claim '215 words' in metadata while actual is '268 words', validation may read wrong source

impact.false_positives: Messages may pass validation despite violating constraints
impact.smoke_tests: Current smoke tests don't verify scope isolation
impact.v10.23_objective: FAILED - staging buffer not truly isolated

enforcement: Delete Artist output from scope BEFORE calling any validation
Validation function signatures accept ONLY staging_buffer parameter
Add scope violation detection to every validation batch
QA reports must include scope isolation verification section

changes.description: Add Artist output deletion step after staging buffer creation

new_content.step_10: DELETE from scope: del artist_output (enforces scope isolation)
new_content.step_13: After validation: Restore artist_output_backup for final message rendering

scope_isolation_enforcement.critical_rule: After step_10, artist_output MUST NOT exist in any scope accessible to validation

python_pseudocode: # Step 9: Backup for later file rendering
# Step 10: DELETE to enforce scope isolation
raise ScopeViolationError('Artist output still accessible after deletion')
# Step 12: Validation can ONLY see staging_buffer

changes.description: Rewrite validation batch signatures to accept ONLY staging_buffer

old_block.note: Current design allows both staging_buffer and artist_output in scope
old_block.vulnerability: Validation could accidentally read artist_output instead of staging_buffer

function_signatures.critical_note: NO artist_output parameter - enforced by function signature

parameter_validation.execute_first: Before any validation logic in each batch
parameter_validation.check: if 'artist_output' in dir() or 'artist_output' in globals(): raise ScopeViolationError()
parameter_validation.error_message: CRITICAL: artist_output accessible during validation - scope isolation violated

data_source_enforcement.critical_rule: NEVER recalculate from Artist output - staging_buffer is ground truth

changes.description: Add scope isolation verification to gate decision logic

scope_isolation_verification.implementation_1: if 'artist_output' in locals() or 'artist_output' in globals(): raise ScopeViolationError('artist_output not deleted before validation')
scope_isolation_verification.implementation_2: if 'staging_buffer' not in locals(): raise ScopeViolationError('staging_buffer not created')
scope_isolation_verification.implementation_3: required = ['K.1_greeting_actual', 'K.3_body_actual', 'full_message_actual']; for section in required: assert section in staging_buffer

pseudocode: raise ScopeViolationError('Artist output still accessible - scope isolation failed')
run_validation_batch_2(staging_buffer)  # Artist output CANNOT be accessed
artist_output = artist_output_backup  # Restore for file rendering

changes.description: Add mandatory scope check as first step in every validation batch
changes.append_to: Beginning of each batch function (batch_1, batch_2, batch_3, batch_4)

implementation: # Proceed with validation using ONLY staging_buffer
mandatory_scope_check.on_violation: HALT_WORKFLOW immediately with scope violation error report

changes.description: Add scope isolation results to validation gate reporting

content.artist_output_deleted: boolean - True if del artist_output executed
content.artist_output_accessible: boolean - False if scope check passes

changes.description: Add scope isolation test suite (12 tests) to verify hard isolation

new_content.priority: CRITICAL - Must pass before v10.23.1 deployment

unit_tests.name: Artist output deletion verification
unit_tests.check: After staging buffer creation, verify artist_output deleted from scope
unit_tests.method: Try to access artist_output variable - should raise NameError

unit_tests.name: Validation function signature check
unit_tests.check: Verify all validation batch functions accept ONLY staging_buffer parameter

unit_tests.name: Staging buffer word count source verification
unit_tests.check: Verify staging_buffer word counts calculated from raw_text

unit_tests.name: Scope check in validation batches
unit_tests.check: Verify each batch has mandatory scope check as first step
unit_tests.method: Code inspection - look for 'if artist_output in dir()' at function start
unit_tests.expected: All 4 batches have scope check before validation logic

integration_tests.name: Artist metadata corruption test
integration_tests.check: Corrupt artist_output metadata before deletion, verify validation unaffected
method: Create staging_buffer with actual K.3 word_count = 215
integration_tests.expected: Validation passes with 215 words, ignores corrupted 999

integration_tests.name: Scope violation detection test
integration_tests.check: Simulate scope violation by NOT deleting artist_output
method: Verify ScopeViolationError raised before any validation executes
integration_tests.expected: ScopeViolationError raised with message about artist_output accessibility

integration_tests.name: E2E word count accuracy test
integration_tests.check: Generate message, manually count words, compare to QA report
method: Generate INMAIL message with K.3 body
Compare to validation result word count
integration_tests.expected: Manual count EXACTLY matches validation word count (zero discrepancy)

integration_tests.name: Backup and restore test
integration_tests.check: Verify artist_output_backup correctly restored after validation
method: Verify artist_output restored with correct content for file rendering
integration_tests.expected: artist_output_backup content matches original, available for rendering

smoke_tests.name: Manual verification test (CRITICAL)
smoke_tests.check: User manually verifies word count accuracy
method: Generate INMAIL message for EXECUTIVE archetype
Copy K.3 body text from QA report or final message
Compare to QA validation report word count
smoke_tests.expected: Word count in MS Word EXACTLY matches QA report (zero phantom words)
smoke_tests.notes: This is the SAME test that failed in Job Workflow v1.6.2

smoke_tests.name: Over-limit detection with scope isolation
smoke_tests.check: Verify over-limit violation detected using staging_buffer only
method: Artist claims 215 words in metadata (false claim)
smoke_tests.expected: Validation fails with message: 'K.3 word count 268 exceeds maximum 250'

smoke_tests.name: Under-limit detection with scope isolation
smoke_tests.check: Verify under-limit violation detected using staging_buffer only
method: Artist claims 200 words in metadata (false claim)
smoke_tests.expected: Validation fails with message: 'K.3 word count 165 below minimum 180'

smoke_tests.name: Scope isolation report verification
smoke_tests.check: Verify validation gate report includes scope isolation section
method: Check validation report for 'Scope Isolation Verification' section
Verify all batches show artist_output_accessible = false
smoke_tests.expected: Report includes scope isolation table with all checks passing

acceptance_criteria.manual_verification: LIC-SCOPE-SMOKE-001 MUST pass (user validates in MS Word)
acceptance_criteria.deployment_blocker: Any critical test failure blocks v10.23.1 deployment

changes.description: Add hard scope isolation rules to critical implementation notes
new_content: SCOPE ISOLATION: After staging buffer creation, artist_output MUST be deleted: del artist_output
SCOPE ISOLATION: Validation functions signature: def validate(staging_buffer: dict) - NO artist_output parameter
SCOPE ISOLATION: Every validation batch MUST check: if 'artist_output' in dir(): raise ScopeViolationError()
SCOPE ISOLATION: QA reports word counts MUST come from staging_buffer[section]['word_count']
SCOPE ISOLATION: Test LIC-SCOPE-SMOKE-001 (manual MS Word verification) MUST pass before production
SCOPE ISOLATION: Backup artist_output before deletion: artist_output_backup = deepcopy(artist_output)
SCOPE ISOLATION: Restore after validation: artist_output = artist_output_backup (for file rendering only)

deployment_instructions.urgency: CRITICAL - Deploy immediately to prevent false positives
pre_deployment: 1. DO NOT deploy v10.23 to production (has scope isolation bug)
2. Apply all 7 changes from this patch (LIC-023.1-001 through LIC-023.1-007)
4. Verify 100% pass rate on all tests
deployment: 1. Deploy v10.23.1 (with scope isolation fix) to test environment
- Calculate word count in MS Word
4. If all 3 match perfectly → proceed to production
5. If ANY mismatch → DO NOT DEPLOY, debug scope isolation
post_deployment: 3. Collect user feedback on QA report accuracy
4. Run regression tests daily for first week
5. If any scope violations detected → immediate rollback and investigation

what_failed_in_v1.6.2: Documentation said 'read from staging_buffer' but wasn't enforced
Had 'ignore_artist_metadata' flags but validation still read artist metadata
QA reported 129 words but actual text was 111 words (18 word phantom count)
User discovered bug via MANUAL_001 test (MS Word verification)
what_fixed_it_in_v1.6.3: HARD scope isolation: del artist_output before validation
Function signatures enforced: def validate(staging_buffer: dict) ONLY
Scope checks in every validation: if 'artist_output' in dir(): raise ScopeViolationError()
Comprehensive test suite: 12 tests including manual MS Word verification
applied_to_lic_v10.23.1: Same scope check in every validation batch
